CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_accounts" (
	"user_id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"email" text NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"function" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	"active_agency" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_agencies" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"workspace_key" text NOT NULL,
	"owner_id" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_invitations" (
	"token_hash" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"email" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	"role" text NOT NULL,
	"expires_at" text NOT NULL,
	"created_by" text NOT NULL,
	"created_at" text NOT NULL,
	"used_by" text,
	"revoked" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
, "profile_id" text)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_invoice_sequences" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"year" integer NOT NULL,
	"issuer_siret" text NOT NULL,
	"prefix" text NOT NULL,
	"next_number" integer NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_issued_invoices" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"draft_id" text NOT NULL,
	"number" text NOT NULL,
	"content" text NOT NULL,
	"issued_at" text NOT NULL,
	"paid_cents" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
, "issuer_siret" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_issuer_sequences" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"year" integer NOT NULL,
	"issuer_siret" text NOT NULL,
	"prefix" text NOT NULL,
	"next_number" integer NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_memberships" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"role" text NOT NULL,
	"joined_at" text NOT NULL
, "profile_id" text)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_project_files" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"agency_id" text NOT NULL,
	"project_id" text NOT NULL,
	"object_key" text NOT NULL,
	"name" text NOT NULL,
	"mime" text NOT NULL,
	"kind" text NOT NULL,
	"size_bytes" integer NOT NULL,
	"width" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"height" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"page_number" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"created_at" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "studio_deadline_index" (
	"id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"project_id" text NOT NULL,
	"title" text NOT NULL,
	"project_title" text NOT NULL,
	"due_date" text NOT NULL,
	"reminder_days" integer NOT NULL,
	"demo" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "studio_workspaces" (
	"user_id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"content" text NOT NULL,
	"revision" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" text NOT NULL
, "write_token" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_agencies_workspace_key_unique" ON "atelier_agencies" ("workspace_key")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "atelier_project_files_object_key_unique" ON "atelier_project_files" ("object_key")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_agency_year" ON "atelier_invoice_sequences" ("agency_id","year")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_draft" ON "atelier_issued_invoices" ("agency_id","draft_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_number" ON "atelier_issued_invoices" ("agency_id","issuer_siret","number")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "issuer_agency_year" ON "atelier_issuer_sequences" ("agency_id","issuer_siret","year")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "membership_agency_profile" ON "atelier_memberships" ("agency_id","profile_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "membership_agency_user" ON "atelier_memberships" ("agency_id","user_id")
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_auth_identities (subject text PRIMARY KEY,user_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE,email text NOT NULL,created_at text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_hosting_transfer (id text PRIMARY KEY,manifest text NOT NULL,state text NOT NULL,updated_at text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_state (agency_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content JSONB NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_runs (agency_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, trigger_name TEXT NOT NULL, report_json TEXT, origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'atelier', PRIMARY KEY(agency_id,id))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_one_running ON atelier_radar_runs(agency_id) WHERE status='running'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_jobs (agency_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, company TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, first_seen TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL, missing_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'observed', updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(agency_id,id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_source_runs (agency_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(agency_id,run_id,source_id))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_sync (agency_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, checked_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_jobs_agency_seen ON atelier_radar_jobs(agency_id,last_seen)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS atelier_radar_runs_agency_started ON atelier_radar_runs(agency_id,started_at)
